rows.label: Aaron Rodgers
rows.hook: succeeded Brett Favre as a starting quarterback and won four league MVP awards

rows.label: Patrick Mahomes
rows.hook: is a quarterback famous for no-look passes and sidearm throws on the way to multiple championship rings

rows.label: Peyton Manning
rows.hook: is a quarterback famous for loud pre-snap audibles, often shouting 'Omaha'

rows.label: Eli Manning
rows.hook: is a quarterback who twice beat Tom Brady's team in the title game, including a famous helmet catch drive

rows.label: Jalen Hurts
rows.hook: is a quarterback famous for a nearly unstoppable quarterback sneak play nicknamed the 'Brotherly Shove'

rows.label: Kurt Warner
rows.hook: is a Hall of Fame quarterback who went from stocking grocery shelves to league MVP

rows.label: Terry Bradshaw
rows.description: American football player and sports analyst (born 1948)
rows.hook: was a quarterback who won four championships in six seasons and later became a TV studio host

rows.label: Troy Aikman
rows.hook: was a quarterback of a 1990s dynasty and teamed with Emmitt Smith and Michael Irvin

rows.label: Cooper Kupp
rows.hook: is a wide receiver who won the receiving triple crown in a record-setting season

rows.label: Drew Brees
rows.description: American football player and television analyst (born 1979)
rows.hook: is a quarterback who rallied a Gulf Coast city after Hurricane Katrina and set a career passing yards record

rows.label: John Elway
rows.hook: was a quarterback who retired after back-to-back titles and later ran the front office of his old team

rows.label: Emmitt Smith
rows.hook: is the NFL's all-time leading rusher

rows.label: Jerry Rice
rows.hook: is widely considered the greatest wide receiver ever, holding the career records for yards and touchdowns

rows.label: Von Miller
rows.hook: is a star pass rusher who earned the title-game MVP as a defender

rows.label: Joe Montana
rows.hook: was a quarterback famed for calm late-game comebacks and four championship wins

rows.label: Ray Lewis
rows.hook: was a menacing linebacker famous for his energetic pregame dance

rows.label: Joe Namath
rows.hook: famously guaranteed an upset win before the biggest game of his career

rows.label: Hines Ward
rows.hook: was a receiver known for his constant smile and ferocious downfield blocking

rows.label: Steve Young
rows.hook: was a left-handed quarterback who replaced a legend and threw six touchdowns in a title game

rows.label: Julian Edelman
rows.hook: was a receiver famed for a juggling catch just off the turf in a huge comeback win

rows.label: Roger Staubach
rows.description: American football player and Navy officer (born 1942)
rows.hook: was a Navy graduate quarterback nicknamed 'Captain America' and known for his Hail Mary pass

rows.label: Marcus Allen
rows.hook: was a running back who set a long-standing record with a 74-yard touchdown run in a title game

rows.label: Phil Simms
rows.hook: was a quarterback who completed nearly every pass in a title game, then became a TV analyst

rows.label: Terrell Davis
rows.hook: was a running back who played through a migraine to help win a championship

rows.label: Bart Starr
rows.hook: led a legendary coach's team to wins in the first two title games

rows.label: Franco Harris
rows.hook: is remembered for the 'Immaculate Reception', one of the most famous plays ever

rows.label: Lynn Swann
rows.hook: was a ballet-trained receiver famed for acrobatic catches
